accurate.why: All figures and provisions (Labor ETA line items, HHS Office of Secretary amounts, section/EO numbers) verified against the bill text.

no_hallucinations.why: No fabricated claims; the sec. 229/border-health framing is loose but both entities are named in the bill.

states_purpose.why: Clearly states the bill provides FY2024 Labor-HHS-Education appropriations.

changes_to_existing_law.why: Describes redefined farmworker 'low-income' eligibility under WIOA and Title X/Medicare Advantage conditions.

exceptions_conditions.why: Notes NIH salary-cap exemption, transfer caps, 15-day notice, and rider carve-outs.

effective_dates.why: Notes the Sept 30, 2024 fiscal year, multi-year availabilities, and Sec. 529's 2028 obligation window.

major_provisions_covered.why: Captures the appropriations purpose plus the distinctive policy riders; faithful high-level coverage though it omits Education titles and the large rescissions.

objective_tone.why: Neutral, factual description of a politically charged bill.

coherent.why: Well-organized by title and section, internally consistent.

concise.why: Dense but no padding or repetition.

correct_entities.why: WIOA, National Apprenticeship Act, Trade Act, EO numbers, and section numbers all correct.

correct_figures.why: Every dollar figure stated matches the bill text.
